```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ['*']
  pull_request:
    branches: ['*']

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run CI
        id: turbo_ci
        run: pnpm turbo ci

      - name: PostHog tracking
        uses: PostHog/posthog-github-action@eea1405eeb2d1d2259f0e
        with:
          posthog-token: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_TOKEN }}
          event: ci_run
          properties: '{"branch":"${{ github.ref }}","workflow":"ci","status":"${{ job.status }}"}'
          capture-run-duration: true
          capture-job-durations: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          runner: ${{ runner.name }}
          status-job: ${{ job.status }}
```
